book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Karasaras en Silepen Sihpw
“I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: mehmen me sohte pedolong nan wenihmwen kelen sihpw, ahpw doulong ni ehu soangen ahl tohrohr, iei ih lipirap emen, oh mehn kulih.
A me kin pedolong nan wenihmwo, iei ih me silepen sihpw.
Silepen wenihmwo kin ritingadahng silepen sihpwo; sihpw kan kin rong ngile, oh ni eh kin ekerki nah sihpw kan adarail, e ahpw kin kahluwairailla liki.
Ni eh kapedoi irail, e ahpw kin tieng mwohrail, oh sihpw kan kin idawehn, pwehki arail anlahr ngile.
Re sohte pahn idawehn emen tohrohr, pwe re pahn tangasang, pwehki arail sahn ngile.”
Sises mahsanihong irail karasaras pwoatet, a irail sohte wehwehki soahng kan me e ketin mahmahsanihong irail.
Sises Ih me Silepen Sihpw Mwahu
Sises eri pil pwurehng mahsanih, “I ndaiong kumwail ni mehlel: ngehi me wenihmwen kelen sihpw akan.
Irail koaros me pwarodohr mwohi, lipirap, oh mehn kulih kei, ahpw sihpw akan sohte rong irail.
Ngehi me wenihmwo. Mehmen pedolong nan wenihmw wet pahn mourla. E pahn pedolong oh pedoi, oh diarada kene mwenge.
Lipirap kin kohdo pwe en pirapa, kemehla, oh kauwehla. A ngehi, I pwarodohr pwe irail en ahneki mour, iei, mour unsek.
“Ngehi me silepen sihpw mwahu. Silepen sihpw mwahu kin tounmeteikihla eh mour pwehki nah sihpw kan.

Tohndoadoahk men, me kaidehn silepen sihpw, oh pil kaidehn uhdahn nah sihpw akan, ni eh kin kilangada kidien wel eh kohkohdo e kin keseirailla oh tangdoaui. Kidien welo eri kin saikedi sihpw kan oh pwakihirailpeseng.
Me ale pweipweio kin tangdoaui pwehki eh doadoahkohngete pweine, oh sohte mwahn nsenohki sihpw kan.
Ngehi me silepen sihpw mwahu. Duwen Sahm eh mwahngih ie, oh I ese Sahm, pil duwehte ngehi, I ese nei sihpw kan oh irail pil kin ese ie. Oh I pahn tounmeteikihla ei mour pwehki irail.
Pil mie ekei nei sihpw me sohte mi nan kehl wet. I uhdahn pahn weiraildo, oh re pahn rong ngilei. Eri, re pahn wiahla pwihn sihpw teieu, oh sileparail pahn metehmen.
“Semei kin poakohng ie, pwehki ei kin tounmeteikihla ei mour, pwe I en kak pwurehng ale.
Sohte me pahn kihsang ei mour, a pein ngehi me tounmeteikihla. Mie ei manaman en tounmeteikihla, oh pil mie ei manaman en pwurehng ale. Iei duwen me Sahmo mahsanihong ie pwe I en wia.”
Eri, mehn Suhs ako pil pwurehng liaktohrohrpeseng pwehki mahsen pwukat.
Me tohto nanpwungarail ahpw nda, “Ngehn suwed mi reh, oh pweipwei men ih! Dahme kahrehda kumwail rongki?”
A pil ekei nda, “Aramas me ngehn suwed mi reh sohte kak koasoia mepwukat. Ia duwen ngehn suwed eh kak kapehdpeseng pwoaren mesen aramas maskun?”
Mehn Suhs akan Sohte Pwungki Sises
Eri, ahnsowo ahnsoun Sarawien Isimwas
nan Serusalem (nan sounpwong en kopou.)
Sises ketiketseli nan Tehnpas Sarawio nan Palangk en Solomon.
Mehn Suhs ako eri kapilpene oh patohwanohng, “Ia erein at pahn peipeikasal kin uhk? Ma iei kowe Mesaia, kadehdehiong kiht ni sansal.”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I ndaiongkumwailehr, a kumwail sohte men kamehlele ie. Doadoahk ko me I wiadahr ni manaman en Semei, iei me kadehdehiedahr.
A kumwail sohte pahn kamehlele, pwehki kaidehn kisehn nei sihpw kumwail.
Nei sihpw akan kin rong ngilei; oh I ese irail, oh re kin idawehn ie.
I kihong irail mour soutuk, oh re sohte pahn mehla. Sohte emen me pahn adihirailsang rehi.
Semei me ketikihong ie irail, me lapasang mehkan koaros. Oh sohte emen me kak adihasang nin limen Semei.
Semei oh ngehi metehmen.”
Mehn Suhs ako eri pwurehng rik takai pwe re en katehki.
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “I wiadahr doadoahk mwahu tohto mwohn masamwail me Sahmo ketikihong ie pwe I en wia. Eri, mehn ia doadoahk rehn doadoahk pwukat me kumwail pahn katehkin ie?”
Mehn Suhs ako ahpw sapeng, patohwanohng, “Kaidehk doadoahk mwahu me se men katehkinuhkedi, ahpw pwehki omw kin lahlahwe Koht! Pwehki kowe, aramas emen, ke ahpw kin song en wiahkin uhk Koht!”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “E ntingdier nan amwail Kosonnedo me Koht ketin mahsanih, ‘Kumwail koht kei.’
Eri, kitail ese me dahme Pwuhk Sarawi koasoia me mehlel kohkohlahte; oh Koht ketin kahdanekin irail koht kei, irail aramas akan me sapwellime mahsen kohwongehr.
A ngehi, me Sahm ketin piladahr oh kadariedohr nin sampah, eri, ia duwe, kumwail kak koasoia me I lahlahwe Koht pwehki ei nda me ngehi Sapwellimen Koht?
Ma I sohte kin kapwaiada doadoahk kan en Semei, eri, kumwail dehr mahs kamehlele ie.

A ma I kin wiahda, mehnda ma kumwail sohte kamehlele ie, a kumwail en kamehlele ei doadoahk kan, pwe kumwail en mwadang esehkihda oh wehwehkihda me Sahmo kin ketiket nan mohngiongi, oh ngehi, kin mihmi nan kupwur en Sahmo.”
Irail ahpw pil pwurehng rapahki pwe re en koledi, e ahpw ketin pitsang ni pehrail.
Sises eri ketin pwurala oh kotehla Pillap Sordan ong ni wasa me Sohn wiewiahier papidais ie mahso; e ahpw ketiket wasao.
Aramas tohtohie ahpw pokondohng reh. Irail eri nda, “Sohte kilel me Sohn wiadahr, ahpw mehkoaros me e ndahki duwen ohl menet me inenen mehlel.”
Eri, aramas tohto wasao ahpw pwosonla Sises.
